title: Introduction to Machine Learning
summary: The document introduces machine learning as a subset of artificial intelligence that learns from data. It covers foundational concepts including supervised learning, which uses labeled data to learn mapping functions, and unsupervised learning, which identifies hidden patterns in unlabeled data. It also briefly discusses machine learning applications across industries, with a focus on natural language processing as a key area enabling computers to understand and process human language.

title: Chapter 1: Foundations
summary: The document introduces machine learning and covers its basic fundamentals. It explains that machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that learns from data, then outlines two core learning approaches: supervised learning, which uses labeled data to learn mappings, and unsupervised learning, which finds patterns in unlabeled data. It also begins discussing applications of machine learning across industries, with a focus on natural language processing as a field that enables computers to understand and process human language.
